description: Remove stray tracked *.log files from git

Verify + remove dead client-side source files. DONE: retried git rm on the 21 confirmed-dead files, no sandbox block this time (prior block was transient/session-specific, not persistent). Deleted, staged, tsc --noEmit clean in main checkout.

Verify + remove dead server-side source files from graphify candidate list. DONE: retried git rm on the 5 confirmed-dead files (cache.middleware.ts, errorHandler.middleware.ts, permissions.service.ts, record.service.ts, tenantService.service.ts), no sandbox block this time. Deleted, staged, tsc --noEmit clean in main checkout (required npm install first, node_modules was missing).

Root-cause login/logout session flicker. DONE: race between module-level `store.dispatch(fetchSession())` in _app.tsx:16 and components (Navigation.tsx, SubscriptionGate.tsx, PermissionGate.tsx, CheckoutGuard.tsx) that read `isAuthenticated` without gating on `isAuthenticating`. CheckoutGuard.tsx:16-19 actively redirects an already-logged-in user to /auth/login during the race window. NOT a session/token strategy issue - cookie/JWT mechanism untouched. See TASK-06 for the fix.

Implement session-flicker fix: move fetchSession() dispatch into useEffect in _app.tsx; gate Navigation.tsx/SubscriptionGate.tsx/PermissionGate.tsx/CheckoutGuard.tsx on isAuthenticating before branching auth UI. UI-lifecycle only, no auth/session/cookie strategy change. DONE: implemented by frontend-dev, mirrored into main checkout by team-lead, tsc --noEmit clean in main checkout, security-auditor reviewed all 5 files -> approved, no regressions, no authorization bypass, cookie/JWT mechanism confirmed untouched. Outstanding: before/after Playwright screenshot not captured (no DB/backend available in sandbox) - flagged as outstanding QA evidence, not blocking given security sign-off.
Architecture structural review (layering, circular imports, @shared consistency) via project-graph

Bring stack up via docker compose, full qa-devops Playwright click-through, inline-fix quick established-pattern bugs found: (1) docker-compose port conflicts + missing shared/ volume mount for @shared/* resolution, (2) client auth calls hitting wrong URL because NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL_LOCAL_API was never set, (3) image URL concatenation missing '/' separator crashing next/image across ~13 files, via new getImageUrl() helper.
